column1: # Copied from the shared project files, alexandria/LAYER_ORDER.tsv (made by the Lingua thread's layer_order.py).
# Layer build order from the matrix glue (who uses whom), measured on the repository 2026-10-15.
# order: the core first (it boots first), then each layer after every layer it uses (cycles broken by
#   how much others lean on it); layers with no files yet last, in app order.
# leaned_on: link weight from other layers into this one; layers_leaning: how many other layers use it.
# uses_others: link weight from this layer out; reuse: uses_others / (uses_others + inside), the share of
#   its links that land on another layer's code. files: files living in the layer today (0: app not built).
# foundation: rank by how many other layers use it (then by link weight): build the most leaned-on first.
